name: Regression Lab
desc: A least-squares regression lab: true-slope, intercept, noise and point-count sliders drive the data, with the fitted line, R², RMSE and residuals shown live.
controls: True-slope, intercept, noise and point-count sliders, four presets (clean/noisy/outlier/flat), regenerate/clear buttons, residuals toggle, click-to-add-points; keys 1–4 load presets, R regenerates, C clears
creator: Original build (Dragon Gaming Assets)
